title: Normalize Trinity Plugin Crate to Consistency Contract
description: Normalize trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Jack + Rewrite apps) onto the shared framework SDK primitives per the Consistency Contract: adopt PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder) from semio_framework_plugin, adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing hand-rolled label structs and label-map functions, adopt Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) replacing duplicated test scaffolding, fix region naming/order to canonical (Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests), confirm C1 naming and resource_kind declarations. Scope: trinity/plugin/rs/** only; do not touch trinity_jack's public API surface (Wave-3 depends on its current shape).
summary:
Normalized trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Jack + Rewrite apps) onto the shared framework SDK primitives. Adopted PanelKit: removed both modules' hand-rolled tree_item/tree_item_with_action (which were missing the `loading` field UiTreeItemNode/UiTreeSectionNode/UiTreeNode/UiSectionNode now require — a real pre-existing compile bug) in favor of semio_framework_plugin::{tree_item, tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder}; build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree in both apps now build on PanelTreeBuilder, and the remaining raw UiSectionNode literals (inspector empty/missing states, parameters panel) got the missing `loading: None` field. Adopted Terminology: TrinityJackLabels/TrinityRewriteLabels converted from hand-rolled struct+EN/DE consts+resolver to the app_labels! macro + resolve_labels::<T>(); the two CommandLabels action-label functions now use localized_label_map; both DocumentApp::app_labels() impls now build AppLabelsOverlay via the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder instead of a full struct literal. Adopted Testkit: local meta()/new_app() in both apps' test modules now delegate to testkit::meta/testkit::new_app; app_jack's undo-redo, two-instance-convergence, and ingest-idempotency tests now call testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent (keeping trinity's own action names/probes as closures); app_rewrite's one undo-redo-shaped test (set_lhs_json_undo_redo_round_trip) was converted the same way (it has no convergence/idempotency test to convert). Regions: reorganized both app_jack and app_rewrite into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests order (previously CommandLabels sat after the App impl in both, and each had ad hoc Runtime/Lod/MediaGraph or Runtime/Envelope(mismatched)/MediaGraph regions); fixed a pre-existing region-marker bug where app_rewrite's Runtime region opened as "🔖Runtime" but closed as "🔖Envelope"; fixed both apps' Manifest regions, which were missing their //#endregion marker entirely. Kept the crate-level "🔖Bundle" registration region name (matches the already-normalized gis/flow precedent — Bundle is the crate-wide plugin registration, distinct from each app's own Manifest region). C1 (struct naming) was already contract-compliant (TrinityJackPlayApp/TrinityRewritePlayApp already match PascalCase(app-id)+App) — no renames needed. C4 (pub mod app_jack/app_rewrite layout) was already correct — kept as-is. Verified trinity_jack was never touched (only trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs was edited) so Wave-3's writer migration is unaffected.

Verification performed: full-file brace/paren/bracket balance check; a scripted region-marker matcher confirming every //#region has exactly one correctly-named //#endregion with no mismatches, no orphans, and canonical relative ordering in both app modules; cross-referenced every renamed/adopted identifier (tree_item, tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder, app_labels!, resolve_labels, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt, is_de_locale, testkit::*) against their real signatures read directly from framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit regions; grepped for zero residue of the old hand-rolled tree_item/tree_item_with_action fns, the old trinity_jack_labels/trinity_rewrite_labels resolver fns, and the old mismatched/stray region names (Runtime/Lod/MediaGraph/Envelope); confirmed no duplicate fn/struct definitions after the region merges; confirmed trinity-wide grep shows TrinityJackPlayApp/TrinityRewritePlayApp only appear in this one file. Deliberately skipped: a confirmed `cargo check -p trinity-plugin` — it blocked on the build-directory file lock for the full budget (shared with ~100+ concurrent sessions per the verification policy) and never returned; skipped a full `rustfmt --check` diff review because the file was already ~1550 lines non-rustfmt-clean before this change (confirmed via a rustfmt --check run against the pre-edit backup) — none of the diff is attributable to this pass, so I did not chase it. Did NOT add a .resource_kind(...) to the Rewrite app's builder — the Jack app already has one (graph.trinity / MeshOnly) but the Rewrite app (a rule/behavior editor over lhs/rhs/parameter JSON, not an importable media asset) has never had one; this mirrors the existing precedent in gis (its second app, Gis3dPlayApp, also has no resource_kind) so I left it alone rather than inventing a resource kind Wave-1 evidently didn't intend.

Nothing needed flagging for Wave-4's audit — all business logic (jack query execution, rewrite rule compilation/application, LOD, media-graph projection, inspector fields) was fully expressible on top of the existing SDK primitives; the only non-canonical thing kept is the app-specific selection_ids() fallback wrapper (nodeIds/nodeId in addition to ids) in both apps, which the framework's own PanelKit docstring explicitly calls out trinity as one of the apps expected to keep for now.
